name: .alpha.-tocopherol + silicon dioxide + sodium pyrophosphate
uses: Apply an appropriate amount to your toothbrush and brush your teeth by brushing.
otcwarn: Warnings Keep out of reach of children ■ If more than used for rinsing is accidentally swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. Other Information ■ Store in an airtight container at room temperature ■ Date of use : 36 months from the date of manufacture
